title: What to Pack for Your Dog's Boarding Stay (Simple Checklist)
keyword: what to pack for dog boarding
meta: What to pack for your dog's boarding stay at Four Paws Inn in Miramar. A short, simple list: food in Ziploc bags, leash, any medicine. We have beds and supplies.
body: Packing for your dog's boarding stay is easier than you think. Here is the short list we give every family at Four Paws Inn in Miramar.
## What to bring
**Food.** Bring your dog's own food, one meal per Ziploc bag. Same food as home means the same routine, every meal.
**Leash.** Have it on when you arrive.
**Medicine.** Bring any medicine your dog takes, with clear notes on how to give it.
**Vaccine records.** Vaccines must be current. Send the records when you book.
## What to leave at home
Beds, bowls and toys. We have beds and supplies for every stay. One less thing to fit in the car.
## Tell us about your dog
The more we know, the better we can plan their stay. Tell us what they love, what makes them nervous and what helps them calm down.
## Drop off is quick
Drop off is curbside. Text us your ETA when you are on the way, and we come out to your car. Drop off and pick up are seven days a week, 9 AM to 12 PM or 4 PM to 6:30 PM.
## After you book
You get our welcome guide by email with everything you need to know before drop off.
## Ready to book?

Send us your dates and tell us about your dog. Call or text (754) 277 2325, or book at fourpawsinn.co. A 25% deposit holds your dates, and the rest is paid before drop off. Four Paws Inn has 230+ Google reviews and a 4.9 star rating.

title: Dog Boarding Near Hollywood, FL: Cage Free Home Boarding in Miramar
meta: Dog boarding near Hollywood, FL at Four Paws Inn in Miramar. Cage free home boarding, outside to play every hour, a daily video update. 230+ Google reviews.
body: Looking for dog boarding near Hollywood, FL? Four Paws Inn is a family run, cage free dog boarding home in Miramar, a short drive west of Hollywood.
## A real home
Your dog stays in our family home with a big backyard. No kennel rows. Dogs go outside to play every hour, and they sleep inside a calm house.
## New dogs start slow
New dogs never go straight into the group. First they get one on one time with our team. Then quiet time to explore. Then they meet the group slowly, when they are ready.
## Two dogs? They stay together
Siblings always stay together here. If one loves to play and one is shy, the social one plays with the group and comes back inside to their sibling.
## Daily updates
One daily video update is included with every stay.
## Price

We charge by the day. Dogs under 50 lb are $60 a day. Dogs over 50 lb are $75 a day. Puppies and senior dogs are $80 a day. Each additional dog is $5 a day less. If you pick up before 10 AM, your last day is not charged. No hidden fees.
## Drop off and pick up
Seven days a week, 9 AM to 12 PM or 4 PM to 6:30 PM, curbside. We are at 1700 SW 137th Way, Miramar, FL 33027.
## Ready to book?

Rabbits, birds, reptiles and small mammals.
## Every pet is different

Our team confirms the price for each exotic pet after we learn about their needs. You will know the full price before you book. No hidden fees.

Bring your pet's food and anything they need for their daily routine. Our team will tell you what else to pack when we confirm your stay.
